## [1.41.0](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/compare/v1.40.0...v1.41.0) (2026-10-05)

### Bug Fixes

* **Klassik Radio+ - Unlock premium:** hide trial banner on Start tab ([b25be47](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/b25be476e2a13541fbf851144c2da5051637cf17))
* refuse to patch APKs not signed by the app developer ([2075d7d](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/2075d7d04cf4681604e37846f9a411ecc003486a)), closes [#149](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/issues/149)

### New Features

* **Keepa - Clone app:** install several copies side by side ([3c7012b](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/3c7012b4053c968709634b8c6b54171d96429610))
* **Keepa - Disable tracking:** stop Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics collecting usage data ([da6ec6e](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/da6ec6e553f6c9e2a8ed421bc2a4956e36cfe5be))
* **Keepa - Multiple accounts:** track products across several accounts in one install ([528a3ff](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/528a3ff90d791a552f784d5870a1587dae49c1c8)), closes [#144](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/issues/144)

* **Keepa - Show offer counts:** show the new and used offer counts in the product overview ([ef44c5f](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/ef44c5f66e17396a8837dc597f739b9a171ed4f1))
* **Keepa - Unlock price increase tracking:** add rise option to price watches ([36f94eb](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/36f94eb8117476d6fbf26b6e9ca9c6dfc8a13c29))
* **Klassik Radio+ - Unlock premium:** lift hourly skip limit ([ac2b666](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/ac2b6668d139d9cfd7cce7716593c5702261c9ca)), closes [#145](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/issues/145)
